0_concept_reference.notes: Done 2026-09-25. The user supplied the T-pose front (TRELLIS input) and a full turnaround sheet (references/BRAX_sheet_turnaround.png: A-pose front/side/back, key art, gauntlet close-ups, face close-up, chest-sigil detail, five colour swatches). The sheet is the authority for the side and back shapes, the back crack pattern, the gauntlet construction and the face. Optional and not blocking: a dedicated 3/4 turnaround and a colour script with lighting/Heat/Meltdown states.

front.notes: The user supplied it as the approved front concept (1536x1024, T-pose, flat navy background). references/brax_concept_front.png is a byte-identical copy that the stage-1 track uses as TRELLIS input. The user's turnaround sheet (references/BRAX_sheet_turnaround.png, approved 2026-09-25) adds a relaxed A-pose front; the T-pose front stays the TRELLIS input and the proportion reference.

color_script.notes: Optional. The approved sheet carries five colour swatches (item colour_swatches). A dedicated colour script (game light, Heat 0 / Heat max, Meltdown) is still useful for the shader and VFX pass but no longer blocks stage 2; the prompt is kept in turnaround_prompts.md#6-colour-script.

palette.notes: Automated measurement of the approved front (13 swatches, shadow/base/highlight). The values are exact for the front plate, so engineering can use them for shader and UI colours now. This is a STAND-IN for the painted colour-script sheet, which it does not replace: it has no lighting states and no Heat or Meltdown looks. Since 2026-09-25 the user-approved swatches (item colour_swatches) are the authority for the five key hues; this measured palette fills in the other materials.

brief.notes: Built from the content rows, the approved front and measurements. Section 7's design proposals are settled by the approved turnaround sheet (addendum at the end of section 7).

readability_check.notes: 2D approximation: the front plate at 65/86 px, on the biome grounds and pasted into a client frame. Findings are in brief.md section 5. The real check through the 55-degree camera belongs to stage 1.

colour_swatches.notes: The five swatch diamonds at the sheet's lower right (median of a 9x9 px patch at each centre). The measured palette.json (item palette, a stand_in) keeps the per-material shadow/base/highlight values; where the two disagree the approved swatches win.

1_blockout.notes: SCULPT REFERENCE ONLY - never shipped, never copied to assets/models/, never rigged. TRELLIS.2 (Pixal3D pruned) on the approved front, birefnet cut-out verified (full arm span and fingertips kept), 3 seeds (101/202/303) at the user's character settings (700k faces, 4096 px). s202 picked for its faceted gauntlet plates, head/beard and colour blocking; known defects (thin fingers, no lava-crack geometry or emissives, soft face, detached lower-leg shells under the skirt, fused cloth, baked lighting) are listed in reports/blockout_report.md section 6. The seed pick is an engineering judgement; the stage-2 artist may switch to s101 (single watertight surface) and should treat the concept and the approved sheets as the authority wherever the mesh disagrees.

2_production_mesh.produced_by: AI (Claude) with the automated Blender 5.2 chain tools/blender/gf_hero/run_stage2.py; no human artist
2_production_mesh.decision: 2026-09-25: no human artist for stage 2; the AI pipeline makes the production mesh at production quality (the user's decision, relayed by the workflow coordinator).
2_production_mesh.notes: Production mesh made by the AI pipeline, not a stand-in: the CC0 MakeHuman hm08 topology (MPFB used as a tool only) reduced to game density with its joint loops, fitted to the approved sculpt reference (landmark warp + surface fit), extra knee, elbow and wrist loops, bare forearms and hands (weapons decision), a grin (parted lips, teeth); separate closed parts (hair and beard shells with chunky clumps, belt, sash with front and back tails, underskirt, 60 rigid skirt plates, ankle and wrist wraps); one 2048 atlas at one texel density; a tangent-space normal map baked from the sculpt (cage, hit-distance mask, normalised blur) plus its cavity and AO and a self-AO of the parts folded into the hand-painted NPR base colour; emissive: bold chest sigil with rays and a white-hot core, a lava crack network over chest, shoulders, forearms and back, the spine crack, the eyes. Polish pass 2026-09-25 (orchestrator review: the blockout column read more like the concept at game size): gauntlets rebuilt on the blockout's own gauntlet, normal/AO bakes, bolder emissive, face and hair/beard. Review sheets in reports/stage2/ (before/after in stage2_polish_before_after.png); honest findings and the acceptance checklist in reports/stage2_production_mesh.md. The remaining human gate is the user's visual approval (item user_visual_approval).

user_visual_approval.notes: The user's final visual approval of the AI-made mesh and textures (sheets in reports/stage2/). Record it with approved_by / approved_on on this item.

3_rig.notes: The GF_Hero_v1 master skeleton does not exist yet (docs/ART_PIPELINE.md describes the plan). Auto-rig plus hand weight-paint fixes; a human signs off the weight painting (shoulders, hands, face). Weapon sockets weapon_L / weapon_R (children of hand_L / hand_R) go at the frames in reports/stage2/body_fit.json hand_frames: origin palm centre, +Y along the fingers, +Z out of the back of the hand.

4_animation.notes: The shared clip set on GF_Hero_v1 plus Brax's unique set (proposal in brief.md section 8). Mixamo/ActorCore seeds are prototyping stand-ins only.

5_export_validate.notes: Headless Blender CI writes assets/models/characters/brax.glb, uncompressed because bevy_gltf 0.20 supports no Draco, meshopt or quantisation. A human applies the final Hades-II bar.
